Class ManagerTables

java.lang.Object
ManagerTables
public final class ManagerTables extends Object
Table helpers shared by the manager screens: styling, sorting, and row colors.

    • numericSorter

      public static TableRowSorter<DefaultTableModel> numericSorter(DefaultTableModel m, int[] intCols, int[] moneyCols)
      Row sorter that compares whole-number columns and money columns ("$5.75", "$12.50/hr") by value. Without it the table sorts them as text, so "$10.00" comes before "$5.00".
      Parameters:
      m - the model to sort
      intCols - indexes of the columns holding whole numbers (as Integer)
      moneyCols - indexes of the columns holding money text
      Returns:
      the row sorter, ready to set on a table

    • parseMoney

      public static double parseMoney(String s)
      Turns "$5.75" or "$12.50/hr" back into 5.75 or 12.50.
      Parameters:
      s - the money text
      Returns:
      the amount in dollars
      Throws:
      NumberFormatException - if the text is not a number once the "$" and "/hr" are removed

    • stripedRenderer

      public static DefaultTableCellRenderer stripedRenderer(IntPredicate highlight, Color highlightColor)
      Cell renderer that stripes every other row and paints rows matching highlight (checked by model row, so it still works after sorting) in highlightColor.
      Parameters:
      highlight - tells whether a model row should be highlighted
      highlightColor - the background color for highlighted rows
      Returns:
      the cell renderer
